institutionalHost.name: Croatian Amateur Radio Association (HRS)
institutionalHost.role: Official Host Organization & National Amateur Radio Society of Croatia (IARU Member Society)
institutionalHost.description: Founded in 1924, Hrvatski radioamaterski savez (HRS) unites amateur radio clubs and operators across Croatia. HRS proudly presents WRTC 2030 in Slavonia under the auspices of the WRTC Sanctioning Committee.

tiers.title: Principal Partners
tiers.description: Leading global equipment manufacturers and corporate leaders providing foundational infrastructure for the 60 competition stations.
tiers.packageScope: Transceivers, tower systems, directional yagi arrays, and synchronized power generation for 60 identical field stations.

partners.name: Official Transceiver Partner
partners.subtitle: Equipment Category Leader
partners.description: Providing 120 synchronized transceivers ensuring identical receiver sensitivity, dynamic range, and filter skirts across all operating tents.

partners.name: Official Mast & Antenna Systems Partner
partners.subtitle: Field Hardware Leader
partners.description: Standardized 15-meter crank-up mast systems and matched triband directional yagi arrays engineered for uniform HF launch.

tiers.title: Equipment & Technology
tiers.description: Specialized RF, cabling, network telemetry, and station hardware partners.
tiers.packageScope: Low-loss coaxial feedlines, high-isolation bandpass filters, station automation, uninterruptible power, and referee telemetry systems.

partners.name: RF Filtration & Coaxial Partner
partners.subtitle: Interference Suppression
partners.description: Precision high-power bandpass filtration ensuring zero inter-station intermodulation across the 60 field sites.

partners.name: Contest Logging & Live Telemetry
partners.subtitle: Software & Networking
partners.description: Low-latency wireless station networking streaming score packets to the central scoring engine in Osijek.

tiers.title: Contest Clubs & DX Foundations
tiers.description: International DX foundations, regional contest clubs, and amateur radio federations supporting youth participation and fair competition.
tiers.packageScope: Support for the 3 Youth Teams (under 25), referee travel subsidies, and public radiosport promotion.

partners.name: Worldwide DX & Contest Foundations
partners.subtitle: Global Radiosport Patronage
partners.description: Supporting international radiosport fellowship, youth development, and referee travel logistics.

partners.name: Slavonian Radio Clubs (9A1A, 9A1P, 9A5D, 9A7A)
partners.subtitle: Regional Volunteer Host Network
partners.description: Over 100 dedicated Croatian radio amateur volunteers providing local site preparation, antenna erection, and logistics.

tiers.title: Individual Patrons & Donors
tiers.description: Individual contesters and radiosport enthusiasts worldwide who cherish the heritage and sportsmanship of the World Radiosport Team Championship.
tiers.packageScope: Personal acknowledgement in the official WRTC 2030 commemorative program, website donor roll, and commemorative donor pin.

partners.name: WRTC 2030 International Patron Roll
partners.subtitle: Friends of WRTC
partners.description: Honoring individual operators across all 6 continents whose personal generosity empowers this historic edition in Slavonia.
